t: A rugged AI camera that runs Linux and sees depth on its own.
steps: Buy an OAK 4 S, OAK 4 D, or OAK 4 D Pro from Luxonis or a store such as Knox Labs.
Get a PoE+ injector or a strong USB-C power source.
Install Python and the DepthAI v3 library on your computer.
Connect the camera over USB-C or a network cable.
Run a DepthAI example from the Luxonis docs to see the live color feed.
Try an object detection example and watch the labeled boxes appear.
Package your pipeline as an OAK app to run on the camera by itself.
meta: Open Code. From $849. A few stores.
